scientific_integrity: Combinatorial proof valid for every integer rectangle in the domain; finite adjacency-based brute-force testing independently corroborates selected small graphs. No assertion of independent validation, universally established novelty, or externally certified proof.
scientific_limitations: The enumeration is for maximum failed sets of standard zero forcing on rook graphs only. The known failed zero forcing number and the existence of a 2-by-2 white obstruction are credited to earlier work. It does not enumerate all inclusion-minimal forts or cover other forcing rules. A fully independent mathematical and publication-priority audit has not occurred.
title: Maximum failed zero forcing of rectangular rook graphs: complete extremizer classification and counts
